def choose_move(observation):
    width = observation.get('width', 0)
    height = observation.get('height', 0)
    own_info = observation.get('players', {}).get('own', {})
    own_pos = own_info.get('pos', [0, 0])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('players', {}).get('enemies', [])
    territory_control = observation.get('territory', {}).get('owner', [])
    
    x, y = own_pos

    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Prioritize resource collection
    for r in resources:
        rx, ry = r
        dist = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
        if dist == 1:
            return [rx - x, ry - y]
        elif dist > 1:
            dx_candidate = 1 if rx > x else -1 if rx < x else 0
            dy_candidate = 1 if ry > y else -1 if ry < y else 0
            return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # Pursue or evade enemies
    for enemy in enemies:
        enemy_pos = enemy.get('pos', [0, 0])
        ex, ey = enemy_pos
        dist = abs(ex - x) + abs(ey - y)
        if dist == 1:
            return [ex - x, ey - y]
        elif dist > 1:
            dx_candidate = 1 if ex > x else -1 if ex < x else 0
            dy_candidate = 1 if ey > y else -1 if ey < y else 0
            return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # Territory control: move towards unowned or enemy territory
    for idx, owner in enumerate(territory_control):
        if owner != 'own':
            tx = idx % width
            ty = idx // width
            dist = abs(tx - x) + abs(ty - y)
            if dist == 1:
                return [tx - x, ty - y]
            elif dist > 1:
                dx_candidate = 1 if tx > x else -1 if tx < x else 0
                dy_candidate = 1 if ty > y else -1 if ty < y else 0
                return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # Default to staying put unless on boundary, then move inside
    inside_x = min(max(x, 0), width - 1)
    inside_y = min(max(y, 0), height - 1)
    move_x = 0
    move_y = 0
    if x == 0:
        move_x = 1
    elif x == width - 1:
        move_x = -1
    if y == 0:
        move_y = 1
    elif y == height - 1:
        move_y = -1
    return [move_x, move_y]
